text: At its meeting held March 25 and 26, 2026, City Council appointed Lovisa McCallum to the Toronto Investment Board for a term of office from March 28, 2026 to March 28, 2030, and until a successor is appointed. The new appointment fills the position previously held by Kevin Adolphe whose term ended March 27, 2026.
The Toronto Investment Board received the item for information.
